description: This file defines the 'Team' data model for Mattermost, including its properties, validation, patching, and utility methods.

classes.name: Team
classes.description: Represents a team with properties like ID, name, description, email, type, and constraints.

classes.name: TeamPatch
classes.description: Used for updating team properties with optional fields.

classes.name: TeamForExport
classes.description: Extends Team with additional export-related info like SchemeName.

classes.name: Invites
classes.description: Holds a list of invite entries with email addresses.

classes.name: TeamsWithCount
classes.description: Contains a list of teams and total count for pagination.

methods.name: Auditable
methods.description: Returns a map of team properties for auditing.

methods.name: LogClone
methods.description: Returns a clone of the team for logging purposes.

methods.name: ToEmailList
methods.description: Converts invites to a list of email addresses.

methods.name: Etag
methods.description: Generates an ETag string based on team ID and update timestamp.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Validates the team object for correctness.

methods.name: PreSave
methods.description: Prepares the team object before saving, generating IDs and sanitizing fields.

methods.name: PreUpdate
methods.description: Updates timestamps and sanitizes fields before updating.

methods.name: Sanitize
methods.description: Clears sensitive fields like email and invite ID.

methods.name: Patch
methods.description: Applies a patch to update team properties.

methods.name: IsGroupConstrained
methods.description: Checks if the team is group constrained.
